text: ここは　ひとが　とまる　りょかん　ですじゃ　あいにく　へや　いっぱい　でな
note: The word used is ryokan, a traditional Japanese-style inn with tatami-mat rooms and futon bedding, not a Western-style hotel as the English line has it.
claim: A ryokan is a traditional Japanese inn, typically with tatami-mat rooms and futon bedding.

check.quote: A ryokan is a type of traditional Japanese inn that typically features tatami-matted rooms, communal baths, and other public areas where visitors may wear nemaki and talk with the owner. [...] Bedding is a futon spread out on the tatami floor.
